digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler bridge; many-to-many tracker project mapping
propositions: Teams using multiple tracker projects against one codebase cannot use the bridge because project configuration is hard-wired as a single scalar at three independent points (JiraConfig.project, fetcher.jqls_for, applier.CrossProjectTargetError).

A shared ticket store with per-ticket project and repos fields, storing project mappings at .bridge_state/projects.json, enables many-to-many project-to-repo associations without forcing each fetch pass to see other projects' tickets as remote deletions.

Inbound fetch must fan-out over all configured projects in a single pass, enriching each project's issues independently (parent/comment/issuelink maps per project) and merging results into one snapshot keyed by issue.

Outbound dispatch must use per-ticket project on create and relax the cross-project guard to set membership rather than single-project validation, while refusing mutations targeting projects outside the configured set.
Migration must resolve absent project fields against a legacy default recorded in the mapping with zero events written, using an idempotent ensure unit rather than per-ticket EDIT events.

A store with multiple projects must carry multi-project-bridge in store-compat.json required_capabilities, fail closed on binaries lacking it, and atomically commit the capability stamp and project mapping in one transaction.
